gaps.title: Epidemiological Data Cataloging and Management
gaps.jtbd: When an epidemiologist accesses the system, I want to catalog and manage structured epidemiological datasets and surveillance data, so that quantitative outbreak metrics can be stored and analyzed alongside textual materials.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an epidemiologist, When they submit or query epidemiological data records via the system, Then the system manages, catalogs, and retrieves structured epidemiological datasets.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: brief explicitly requires managing epidemiological data ('управления эпидемиологическими данными'), but existing code only implements document/material endpoints.

gaps.title: User Authentication and Session Management
gaps.jtbd: When a user accesses the knowledge base management functions, I want to authenticate credentials and issue a session token, so that system access and password recovery are tied to authenticated user sessions.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given user credentials, When a user submits a login request, Then the system verifies credentials, generates an authentication token, and establishes a secure user session.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: password recovery features exist without underlying user login, authentication, or session management required for an authenticated management system.
